title: Batman Spawn: The Classic Collection - Hardcover By Doug Moench Chuck Dixon
descriptionText: The product is a hardcover collection of Batman and Spawn comics, featuring classic stories by renowned writers and artists such as Todd McFarlane, Frank Miller, and Doug Moench. Published by DC Comics in 2022, this collection showcases the iconic characters of Batman ( Bruce Wayne) and Spawn in the Modern Age era of US Comics. With a focus on superheroes and the Batman / Spawn crossover, this hardcover edition is a must-have for comic book collectors and fans of the genre. The cover art by Dave McCaig, Todd McFarlane, and Greg Capullo adds a touch of prestige to this limited edition collection.
